h: Peller says he needs to grow into a man after clash with Jarvis
p: Streamer Peller has reportedly spoken out following a heated exchange with his pregnant wife Jarvis, which was said to involve a disagreement over her younger sister and family boundaries. He admitted he has some growing up to do. The couple's fallout has drawn heavy reaction online.
more: Earlier in the week the pair were said to have blocked each other after a live-stream row.
Fans are split between backing Peller and defending Jarvis.
